definition: An autocratic leader is a leader in a social system whose influence is concentrated in a top-down way rather than shared with autonomous subleaders or broad follower-to-follower communication. In the source context, this kind of leadership is described as relatively vulnerable to being controlled or replaced by outside or hidden influential agents.
